description:
[Positions] Copy a stand-alone interview (not a position's step) as a new draft, optionally renamed or into another company you manage. Results are not copied. Into another company the avatar must be shared with it.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

interview_id.description: The stand-alone interview, persona or coaching session to copy (an interview `id` from list_interviews).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

name.description: Name of the copy. Default: the name with " (copy)".

target_merchant_id.description: Copy into another company you manage (admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always copy into their own company). Default: the interview's company.

name: duplicate_interview
title: Copy an interview
